# BAD-029 — Make the deploy password step's dry run a real test

## Brief
The bug this ticket fixed was invisible in CI: the step never fails the job, so a run where it wrote nothing looks identical to one where it worked, and only PR B's /status probe would catch it. The step's shell body is testable with no stack.

Evidence: I proved this fix by extracting the run: body out of server-deploy.yml, pointing it at scratch supabase/.temp/pooler-url files and putting a stub psql first on PATH that prints its argv; eight cases (real format, both placeholder spellings, three malformed shapes, missing file, empty secret) ran in under a second. As test/server/deploy-step.test.mjs that harness would run in ci.yml on every PR and pin the behaviour (which URL, -v pw and -c reach psql) rather than the step's text. Harness: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ericlugo-Personal-BadTakes/32d19997-5c89-4794-b49e-16c300a19e7a/scratchpad/dryrun.sh
